summary: A speaker addresses the graduating Class of 2026, discussing the opportunities and challenges presented by artificial intelligence, while highlighting the contrast between past and present entrepreneurial landscapes.

narrative_structure.purpose: To congratulate the graduates and set the tone for the speech.
narrative_structure.summary: The speaker celebrates the Class of 2026 and introduces the theme of opportunity.

narrative_structure.purpose: To illustrate how entrepreneurship has evolved.
narrative_structure.summary: The speaker contrasts their experiences with technology to the current ease of starting a business.

narrative_structure.purpose: To highlight the implications of AI on jobs and education.
narrative_structure.summary: The speaker discusses how AI is changing the landscape for entrepreneurs and the workforce.

narrative_structure.purpose: To engage with the audience's reactions.
narrative_structure.summary: The speaker acknowledges audience discontent about AI's impact.

narrative_structure.purpose: To emphasize the inevitability of change and reflect on the future.
narrative_structure.summary: Concludes with a reflection on the potential obsolescence of traditional education.

hook_analysis.hook_text: When I was your age, things were different.
hook_analysis.why_it_works: It establishes a relatable context that contrasts the past with the present.

claims.claim: AI will create a frictionless paradise for entrepreneurs.
AI will eventually do every job.

actionable_ideas: Embrace AI tools to enhance your business capabilities.
Adapt to the changing job market by acquiring new skills.
Reevaluate the value of traditional education in light of AI advancements.
title_supporting_quotes: You can start a business with the snap of your fingers.
Your dreams of upward mobility have perished.
creative_reuse_opportunities: Create a video clip discussing the role of AI in entrepreneurship.
Develop a blog post addressing education's value in the AI era.
risk_notes: The speaker's perspective may provoke strong reactions from the audience.
Claims about the future of jobs and education could be controversial.
